This document illustrates the structure of State Cooperative Acts (such as the Karnataka Co-operative Societies Act, 1959 or Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act, 1960). It serves as an architectural placeholder until state-specific Gazette circulars and local departmental notifications are ingested. Under state cooperative legislation, primary cooperative societies are registered with the State Registrar of Cooperative Societies. Provisions govern the minimum number of promoter members required for registration, audit by cooperative departmental auditors, supersession of committees in case of default, and appeals before the Cooperative Tribunal. content: SOURCE STATUS: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT — NOT OFFICIAL. This document provides a template for local district-level fertilizer quota allocation through PACS. Under this placeholder model, PACS members present their land passbook (Pahani / Khasra) and Aadhaar for POS-linked Point-of-Sale subsidized fertilizer distribution (Urea, DAP, MOP). Quotas vary by crop season (Kharif vs Rabi) and irrigated vs rainfed acreage. Actual seasonal quotas and subsidy rates must be confirmed with the local PACS secretary or District Agricultural Officer. SOURCE STATUS: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT — NOT OFFICIAL.
